capabilities: Send the current note to flomo via a sidebar icon or command
Convert frontmatter tags into flomo tags
Format note content (bold title, body, aliases, tags) for flomo
Batch publish notes from a dashboard
Track and update published/unpublished status in frontmatter
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English); manual installation is also supported via a release zip download.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to send notes to flomo, so moving content there requires manual copying and re-tagging.

relations.evidence: An Obsidian plugin that sends your notes to flomo with one click.

summary: Integration that sends Obsidian notes to flomo with one click, converting frontmatter tags to flomo tags and tracking publish status in a dashboard.
